description: This file defines a package for parsing and representing goroutine stack traces in Go. It includes structures and functions to parse stack traces, extract goroutine IDs, states, and functions, and provides methods to retrieve current or all goroutine stacks.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Represents a single goroutine's stack trace, including ID, state, first function, all functions, and the full stack trace.

methods.name: Full
methods.description: Returns the full stack trace string.

methods.name: FirstFunction
methods.description: Returns the name of the first function on the stack.

methods.name: HasFunction
methods.description: Checks if a given function name exists in the stack.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a formatted string describing the goroutine stack.
